purpose: Observe source-derived candidate four binary paths, three base units, fixed cell config and CLI package marker; compare held running daemon bytes. No replacement or package/service operation.

controls.kind: Real new shape/projection/read_content functions with explicit in-memory IO seams

closure: Original guard source full pin -> in-memory module -> unchanged load_current B/Q/source closure -> original full current_guard before content reads.
Exact B daemon process_identity -> live pidfd/held proc/exe -> original executable file/content pin. No filename-based process adoption.
O_PATH|NOFOLLOW on every fixed named component; unsupported ancestor or leaf metadata only. Every content open equals held O_PATH leaf, full SHA twice, held and named ancestors/leaf rechecked.
Independent original full current_guard after; then unchanged full B/Q/source reload and raw guard reread. No parent uniqueness or resource gate relaxed.
Own pool close_all/require_clean; first failure retained, independent after/closure errors secondary. Guard internal descriptors remain its own original finally gates, outside collector counts.
Wrapper -I -B validates complete source SHA before exec, explicitly injects SOURCE_SHA256 into globals, and installs a self-only 55s alarm.
limits_of_result: Stable missing/unsupported paths are observations, not guessed destinations.
Base-unit literal facts do not establish effective service configuration or drop-ins.
Package marker presence/hash does not establish package ownership, rollback archive or database transaction authority.
Collection PASS does not qualify installed source-version, deployment, new baseline, App readiness, or historical London cause/outcome.
